attacker.model: claude (Kiro subagent; exact model version not exposed to the agent)

null-vs-empty.notApplicableReason: The only text column, Warehouse.PackageTypes.PackageTypeName, is NOT NULL, so no NULL text value can be sent; the procedure compares no text.

collation-case.notApplicableReason: The only text column, PackageTypeName, has a unique constraint under the database's case-insensitive collation (UQ_Warehouse_PackageTypes_PackageTypeName), so two names differing only in case are not valid source data, and no text is compared or grouped.

numeric-rounding.notApplicableReason: No decimal or money column or expression: every number is int (outers, quantity per outer) or a key.

cases.label: the later of order and line time decides: order inside with line after @NewCutoff (excluded); order after @NewCutoff with line inside (excluded); both at @NewCutoff (included); later time exactly @LastCutoff (excluded)
cases.reasoning: Last Modified When is the later of the order's and the line's LastEditedWhen and both bounds apply to it. A conversion that filtered order and line separately, or took the earlier time, would list orders 1 and 2 or drop order 3.

cases.label: Ordered Quantity near the int limit: 46340 x 46340 = 2147395600, -46340 x 46341, zero outers, and QuantityPerOuter 0 and 1
cases.reasoning: OrderedOuters * QuantityPerOuter is int x int on both engines. The products stay inside int; a conversion that widened one side to numeric or narrowed to smallint would show. Lines share OrderedOuters and ReceivedOuters values.

top-ties.detail: two rows of Purchasing.PurchaseOrderLines share PurchaseOrderID = 1

cases.label: window at the extremes of datetime2 and dates at the limits: @NewCutoff 9999-12-31 23:59:59.999999; OrderDate 1753-01-01 and 9999-12-31
cases.reasoning: @LastCutoff 0001-01-01 00:00:00 excludes a row edited at that instant and includes one 1 µs later; a row edited at 9999-12-31 23:59:59.999999 equals @NewCutoff and is included. OrderDate is passed through CAST(... AS date) at both ends of the range.

cases.label: inner joins and keys: a missing stock item and a missing package type drop their lines; a package name with a trailing space; ids with gaps and at the int limits
cases.reasoning: Line 7 points at stock item 99 and line 8 at package type 99 (both dropped). Order ids 2147483647, 40 and -2147483648; line and stock item ids jump. Package 'Carton ' keeps its trailing space on output.
